endpoint_proposal.name: publication-grounded qualitative report structure
endpoint_proposal.pattern: P = C AND M AND S
endpoint_proposal.C: Explicit perceptual/represented content referent with named attribute and assertion/denial/hedge
endpoint_proposal.M: Explicitly bound qualitative presentation or current representational-access manner; scope recorded
endpoint_proposal.S: Explicit content/status separability or separability across attributes/contents
endpoint_proposal.attention_extension: A separately measures content plus attention condition/change explicitly related to presentation/emergence/access
endpoint_proposal.appearance_scope: Subset of P with explicit claimed perceptual appearance/experience scope, not just display/sensor/model access
endpoint_proposal.physical_contrast_boundary: Accurate physical contrast can satisfy content attribute; it does not automatically satisfy presentation manner or verify phenomenal clarity
endpoint_proposal.status: Executable development specification; no acceptance thresholds, power, rater qualification or target evaluation certified

inferential_limits: Reference publications independent of project; selection/mapping are project-framed AI synthesis
Published anchors cannot estimate human pattern prevalence or human/model distributional correspondence
Synthetic boundary cases must remain labelled synthetic and excluded from Reporter prompts/training
Ordinary technical/metacognitive descriptions can match structure
No report probabilities or physical measurements verify felt experience
Reporter instrumentation and Controller actions remain separate from proposed attention-control-model locus
Native-trial byte gate applies to numerical psychophysical/native-task transfer, not this qualitative semantic-reference endpoint
